label: common_0170_rival_01
text: Way to go! For a second, I thought you were\nboth goners![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

text: Whoa! What’s wrong?![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0170_rival_02
text:
Maybe it used up all its power?\c
What is this Pokémon, anyway? It kinda looks
like a Cyclizar, but I’ve never seen one quite
like this before...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0170_rival_03
text: And now it looks so different from a minute ago.\nYou think it’s OK?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

text: Hard to say

text: I don’t know

label: common_0170_rival_04
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]You can’t tell either, huh,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0170_rival_05
text: Well, all that aside, I’m seriously glad to have\nyou back up here in one piece![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0170_rival_06
text: Let’s exchange numbers so we can get in touch if\nwe somehow get separated again![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0170_rival_15
text: And here—this’ll let you teach your Pokémon a\nmove to help it battle stronger opponents![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0170_rival_16
text: Think before you use it, though! TMs can only be\nused once.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0170_rival_07
text: You know...that battle down there was really\nsomething.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0170_rival_08
text: You and this fella looked perfectly in sync\nfacing down that Houndoom![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0170_rival_09
text: What?! You didn’t even tell it what to do?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0170_rival_10
text: I guess it’s not like you’re this Pokémon’s\nTrainer yet, huh...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0170_rival_19
text: Oh good! Looks like it perked up a little![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0170_rival_11
text: Do you think this fella was the one making that\nmysterious cry we heard before?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

text: Giaos...

label: common_0170_rival_12
text: Oh man, oh man, oh man! The more I look at this\nPokémon, the more mysterious it seems![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0170_rival_13
text: If you do become its Trainer, you gotta let me\nbattle against it![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

I think we better take a breather.\c
Let’s just get to the lighthouse—that’ll be a good
spot to relax.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
